name: Chem Lab Renovation
brief: Renovate the second-floor chemistry teaching lab during the winter term. Strip the old fittings, remove two partition walls, rewire the lab with new power and data points, add plumbing for wet-lab sinks, install fume-hood ducting and fire safety, lay anti-static vinyl flooring, fit a false ceiling with LED lighting, and install new benches and storage. Needs a building permit and a fire inspection before handover. In-house works team plus contracted trades; the department wants the lab back for the new term, about fourteen weeks.

tasks.name: Install fume‑hood ducting and fire safety ducts
Apply final floor seal and testing

risks.title: Building permit backlog
risks.cause: Municipal permitting office is experiencing a backlog during winter term
risks.event: Building permit is not issued on time
risks.effect: Project start is delayed, pushing back demolition and subsequent works
risks.response: Submit the permit application at the start of the term and schedule weekly follow‑ups with the council

risks.title: Asbestos discovered in old fittings
risks.cause: Legacy lab fittings contain asbestos that was not identified in the initial survey
risks.event: Asbestos is uncovered during stripping of old fittings
risks.effect: Special removal procedures and disposal are required, adding days to demolition
risks.response: Conduct a targeted asbestos survey before demolition and have a licensed removal contractor on standby

risks.title: Hidden structural support in partition wall
risks.cause: The partition walls conceal a load‑bearing beam that was omitted from the as‑built drawings
risks.event: Removal of the walls reveals the beam, requiring redesign of the ceiling support
risks.effect: Installation of the false ceiling framework is postponed while structural redesign is completed
risks.response: Review structural drawings and perform a site‑specific structural check before demolition begins

risks.title: Timber stud supply shortage
risks.cause: Primary supplier of timber studs for the false ceiling has delayed shipments due to winter logistics
risks.event: Insufficient studs are on site when the ceiling framework is scheduled
risks.effect: Carpentry work cannot progress, extending the structural works schedule
risks.response: Order an extra buffer quantity and identify an alternate local supplier as backup

risks.title: Electrical material delivery late
risks.cause: Cable and switchgear are sourced from a single local supplier with limited stock
risks.event: Delivery arrives a week later than planned
risks.effect: Rewiring of power and data points cannot start on time
risks.response: Negotiate a late‑delivery penalty clause and obtain a quote from a second supplier for critical items

risks.title: Plumbing fixtures mismatch
risks.cause: Ordered wet‑lab sink fixtures do not match the specified inlet connections
risks.effect: Fixtures must be reordered and re‑installed, delaying the plumbing work
risks.response: Cross‑check all fixture specifications against the design drawings before placing the order

risks.title: LED lighting wiring errors
risks.cause: Electricians install LED fixtures without verifying circuit protection requirements
risks.event: Post‑installation testing shows frequent tripping of breakers
risks.effect: Lighting fixtures must be rewired, adding rework days before final inspection
risks.response: Perform a dedicated wiring test for each LED circuit before final fixation

risks.title: Fire safety plan approval delay
risks.cause: Fire authority requires additional documentation for the new fume‑hood ducts
risks.event: Fire safety plan is not approved by the scheduled date
risks.effect: Final fire safety inspection cannot be scheduled, risking handover delay
risks.response: Prepare the extra documentation in parallel with the design phase and engage the fire officer early for feedback

risks.title: Cold weather slows floor seal curing
risks.cause: Winter temperatures drop below the recommended curing range for the floor sealant
risks.event: Curing time extends beyond the planned two days
risks.effect: Final floor seal and testing cannot be completed as scheduled, impacting snag inspection timing
risks.response: Use heated curing blankets and monitor temperature to maintain optimal curing conditions
